title: ribes grossularia subsp. atlanticum
intro: Ribes grossularia subsp. atlanticum, commonly known as the Atlantic gooseberry, is a subspecies of the Ribes grossularia species, a deciduous shrub native to the Iberian Peninsula and the Atlantic coastal regions of Europe. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions attributed to Ribes grossularia subsp. atlanticum include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-cancer properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins. The plant's bioactive constituents also exhibit anti-diabetic, anti-hypertensive, and anti-atherogenic activities, making it a promising candidate for the development of novel medicinal products.
